page.layout: One block of running text at the top, then two columns of single-word list lines below it, the left column of German words and the right column of their Latin equivalents. A catchword at the lower right. No page number, no marginal notes.

main_text.p: vero dictionibus praeponebat articulum tho, aut the. Nostratia autem parum dissimilia hæc erant:

page.notes: The left-column list words and the right-column Latin words are set in the printed order; the right column is read after the left. The initial word "vero" is printed with a y-like initial, read as v. Long s is printed in the German words (e.g. "Nostratia", "Fisch") and is transcribed as plain s. The line "Schuuefter" is as printed. No page number is printed.
